text_blocks.snippet: Masks are recommended in certain situations to prevent the spread of respiratory viruses like COVID-19. Wearing a well-fitting mask can help prevent the spread of these viruses. If you test positive for COVID-19, masking is advised. Additionally, consider wearing a high-quality mask if you've been exposed and will be in contact with someone at high risk. For masks to be effective, they must be worn properly.
